messages:
alex_cs: FYI picked up a follow-up from Starlite on their bespoke SIG — they want a mapping of our audit logs to the SIG evidence matrix, confirmation of KMS/HSM usage for key material, and an export of authentication logs covering the last 90 days. due date is next Tue (2026-03-24) and they're asking for artefacts, not just answers.

maria_security: thanks — are they asking for live keys or just proof of HSM-backed CMKs (certs/attestations)?

alex_cs: they explicitly said 'attestations/certs and a short write-up of retention policy + where logs are stored and exported'. also mentioned a small incident last month where their perf alerts showed drop in log volume for ~30m — they want evidence we didn't redact anything relevant.

devon_engineer: I can pull the audit log export and a token-level event dump. quick note: our central retention pipeline did a config rollout 2026-02-19 that shifted cold-tier retention from 180d to 365d for most customers; staging rollback for one bucket briefly created a hole for ~25 minutes on 2026-02-22 (ops_bot has the deploy). will that satisfy them?

ops_bot: Deploy 2026-02-19T04:12Z -> retention-config v3.4 applied to audit-buckets. Rollback event 2026-02-22T08:43Z for bucket audit-cold-03 (duration 25m).

maria_security: we should avoid giving raw key material. Provide: (1) KMS key metadata + HSM attestation doc (vendor-signed), (2) minimal audit log export (CSV) with redaction markers if any, (3) a mapping table that shows audit event types -> SIG questions. I'll draft the write-up.

sam_prod: can we produce an artifact package that contains: readme, key-metadata.json (non-secret), hsm-attestation.pdf, auth-log-export.csv (sha256 checksum.txt), and retention-policy.md? Starlite wants hierarchy mapping for 'Authentication/Authorization logs' specifically.

devon_engineer: yes. I can generate CSV & checksum. two considerations: (a) the CSV will include user id hashes only, not raw usernames, and (b) we need an approval flow from Security to include the attestation PDF.

maria_security: I'll sign off on the attestation inclusion. also will add a small appendix explaining what we store in logs (kv cache hits, model_id, request_id, no prompt bodies unless customer enabled long retention).

alex_cs: Starlite additionally wants a short repro timeline for the 2026-02-22 hole. can we draft a timeline with exact UTC times and exported evidence (ops_bot snippet + SRE notes)? They mentioned they saw 'missing call traces around 08:40-09:05 UTC'.

devon_engineer: timeline drafted: config rollout 04:12Z 2026-02-19; partial rollback 08:43Z 2026-02-22 for bucket audit-cold-03; automated compensating sync started 08:50Z; parity restored 09:08Z. I'll attach the log slices covering 08:30-09:15 with checksums.

maria_security: also prep a short blameless explanation and a mitigation plan (we added a preflight check and a rollback alert rule). include a pointer to our customer-facing retention policy docs.

alex_cs: great. I'll reach out to Starlite's security contact to confirm acceptance criteria (they asked for CSV + attestation + mapping + timeline). will schedule a quick call if they need Q/A.

sam_prod: target: get package ready by EOD today so CS can send initial bundle tomorrow morning and keep the due date cushion. anyone blocked?

devon_engineer: nothing blocking. I'll drop the CSV export and checksum in /s3-auth-exports/starlite/1967890123/ and ping when done.

maria_security: I'll prepare the HSM attestation request and the mapping doc.

alex_cs: thanks team — once exports are in place I'll compose the email. tagging :hourglass_flowing_sand: due 2026-03-24.
